gloss: to repel; to bounce back; to throw back

definitions.gloss: to repel; to bounce back; to deflect
definitions.explanation: For a surface to send an object, light, or water back the way it came, rather than letting it through.

definitions.gloss: to fight off; to withstand; to refuse flatly
definitions.explanation: To hold out against pressure, criticism, or hardship and turn it away, or to reject a demand outright.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す。
⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}して、⟦まぶしい→まぶしい：03737_mabushii⟧くらいだった。
examples.english: The snow reflected the sunlight so brightly it was almost dazzling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}した。
⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}して⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}した→優勝する：25496_yuushousuru⟧。
examples.english: They fought off the criticism around them and won the championship.

examples.english: This company still has the strength to withstand the rise in raw-material costs.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive. What is being turned away takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.
- The intransitive partner ⟦{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}る→跳ね返る：07009_hanekaeru⟧ means to bounce back or to backfire of its own accord.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す: to repel water
- ⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す: to reflect light
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す: to fight off criticism
- ⟦プレッシャー→プレッシャー：07163_puresshaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す: to shrug off pressure

Sense 2 is the one you meet most in sports reporting and business writing, where someone {跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す adversity by performing well anyway. The compound is ⟦{跳|は}ねる→跳ねる：04378_haneru⟧ (to spring) + ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (to send back).
